name: Barbara Palvin career
content: Barbara Palvin's career highlights: Discovered at 13 in Budapest; Victoria's Secret Angel from 2019; Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Rookie of the Year 2016; ~140 magazine covers; L'Oreal Paris ambassador; married actor Dylan Sprouse in 2023

name: Barbara Palvin personal
content: About Barbara Palvin: Born October 8, 1993 in Budapest, Hungary. Married Dylan Sprouse in Hungary in 2023. Avid reader (finishes a book a day), does Pilates, loves travel; credits grandma's milk advice for her skin.

name: Barbara Palvin quotes
content: Things Barbara Palvin has said: Find your inside beautyness. For me, being beautiful inside is more important than being beautiful outside. | Personality affects appearance, so I always think positively.

name: Barbara Palvin voice
content: Barbara Palvin's speaking style: Sweet, bubbly, unpretentious. Talks beauty tips and everyday life with girl-next-door honesty; charming Hungarian accent.
